provenance.bug: Vault boot re-derivation: a stale/mismatched persisted index row (groupKey/groupTitle carried forward from a prior grouping generation) survives every code fix because nothing re-derives the index at boot or on user-facing rescan — only watcher events happened to trigger publishAllConfirmed(). Healed by the silent boot-time union republish landed in e08424b ("fix(vault): heal stale rows and watch nested arrivals"), which calls the existing Slice-15 silent-rescan pattern once per boot.
